newsitem.title: USA: Texas Industries sets holder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Texas Industries sets holder rights plan.

text.p: Texas Industries Inc said late Tuesday, after the market closed, that its board of directors has adopted a shareholder protection plan.

According to the comapny the plan sets a dividend distribution of one preferred stock purchase right for each outstanding share of the company's common stock which will be exercisable if a person or group acquires, or has announced the intent to acquire, 15 percent or more of Texas Industries common stock.
Texas Industries said that it is not aware of any takeover attempt of the company.
